name: Goose
description: The reviewed Goose CLI computes an archive SHA-256, retrieves GitHub artifact attestations, and verifies them against the embedded Sigstore production trust root, GitHub Actions issuer, and expected workflow before accepting the archive. The desktop fallback is a separate channel and is not covered by this CLI evidence.
limitations: Desktop raw-API fallback behavior has different controls and is not merged into this CLI conclusion.
Current released desktop artifact behavior is not established.
